channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: United CEO Scott Kirby tells Gen Z interns to drop excuses, citing mantra from Air Force training
item.description: United Airlines' CEO shares the mantra he learned in pilot training: 'Figure out how to overcome it.'

item.title: Iran claims Strait of Hormuz closed; Trump administration says 9 million barrels per day still flowing
item.description: A large portion of non-Iranian crude continues to move through the strait, unlike Iranian crude, which is not.

item.title: AT&T CMO links 'brand love' to key business metrics: customers 3x less likely to churn, cheaper to acquire
item.description: AT&T's CMO says customers who love the brand are three times less likely to leave, 50% more likely to buy a second product, and cost less to acquire.

item.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO, saying 'I shot Mr. Thompson in Manhattan and he died'
item.description: The 28-year-old entered the plea at a hastily scheduled hearing, sparking a legal dispute over whether he can still face murder charges.
